sheet_from: Data/World9/Tile*.OZJ, from MuMain, decoded under a tk_ prefix: assets/textures is one flat pool and every name is another world's too. TileGround01 is in World9 but no tile wears it, so it is not decoded. docs/tarkan-port.md.
slot_note: World9 ships TileGrass01.OZT, dry straw blades, which MU grows on slot 0 (terrain.py GRASS_BY_MAP[8]): only the north-east town, since the rest of slot 0 is NoGround. Pale desert plateaus at about 1.8 m over a NoGround void that is half the map (51.6%), walled by Object41's cliff faces; the safe town in the north-east (155-251, 28-97).
material_note: Read off the art; the names lie. TileRock01 is the pale cracked sandstone of the desert floor, 59% of the ground: sand. TileGrass01 is straw over sand (the town), TileGrass02 fine tan gravel, TileGround03 dark ochre earth, TileRock03 pale sand with bone-white rubble: sand. TileGround02 is the grey cracked stone of the middle square, TileWood01 pale bleached rock, TileRock02 grey crust with orange lava veins (unwalkable, 0.1%), TileRock04 the darker brown cracked earth of the rock islands and edges: rock. TileWater01 is sand ripples, not water: it takes water only so it slides as MU slides it, one sheet every forty seconds here (ZzzLodTerrain.cpp:3583-3596; the sheet's water_flow 0.5), and the world sheet gives it no wet sheen, as the Lost Tower's lava.
